function need(value, name) {
  if (value === void 0)
    throw new Error(`completion receiving premise missing: ${name}`);
  return value;

  const handle = (run, bucket, token) => {

      const group = `${run}:${bucket}`;
      const interval = (intervals.get(group) ?? 0) + 1;
      intervals.set(group, interval);
      label = `${group}:${interval}`;
      handles.set(object, label);
    };

  const project = (row) => ({

    rank: row.rank,

  callbackCapture.capture = (event, epochId) => {

      epochModels.get(epochId),

          previousHandle: change.previousValue && publicHandle(expected.run, change.previousValue)

  const callWindow = (action) => fixture.operations.call(

  const establishingLoads = (request) => {
    const initiating = need(
      request.appliedLoad,
      `exact queryFn initiating source load`
    );
    if (initiating.source !== request.source || !isDeepStrictEqual(initiating.queryKey, request.queryKey))

  const releaseAnswers = async (action) => {

  const checkSourceAnswerPremises = (action, releasedAt) => {
    const premises = need(
      program.sourceAnswerPremises[action.requirement],
      `authored source-answer premises`
    );
    const witnesses = [];
    for (const premise of premises) {
      for (const key of premise.requiredKeys) {
        const candidates = fixture.providers[premise.source].requests().filter(

            (domain) => premise.permittedKeys.includes(domain)

          candidates.find((candidate) => {

            return isDeepStrictEqual(actual, expected);
          }),
          `applied ${premise.source} knowledge for authored domain ${key}; broader legal batching is an unsupported fixture premise`
        );

  const physicalAction = async (action) => {

  const physicalControl = async (control) => {

      case `hold-demand-sources`:

        break;
      case `arm-subscriber-tail`:

        break;
      case `prepare-held-initial`:
        break;
      // Root was held before actual subscription admission.
      case `arm-initial-status-tail`:

        break;

          () => selectedRequest(program.answerScopes.peer) !== void 0
        );

          () => fixture.writeRoots([

              rank: program.setup.facts.roots[0].rank - program.parameters.rankScale / 10

          ])

        break;
      case `establish-replacement`:
        fixture.providers.roots.hold(false);
        for (const request of pending()) request.answer();
        await fixture.establish();
        break;

  const observe = (boundary) => {
    closeEpoch();
    const common = {
      phase: `completion-baseline-cut`,
      boundary,
      run: model.run,
      view: fixture.read(),
      operations: fixture === originalFixture ? fixture.operations.observations() : originalFixture.operations.observations()
    };
    let observation;
    switch (boundary) {
      case `public-state`:
        observation = { ...common, boundary };
        break;
      case `held-window`:
        observation = {
          ...common,
          boundary,
          operation: `window`,
          pendingProviderAnswers: pending().length
        };
        break;
      case `held-output`:
        observation = {
          ...common,
          boundary,
          receipts: [...boundOutputs].map(([requirement, receipt]) => ({
            requirement,
            target: receipt.target,
            role: receipt.role,
            returnedPromise: receipt.receipt !== true,
            pending: receipt.outcome.state === `pending`
          }))
        };
        break;
      case `source-failed-peer`:
        observation = {
          ...common,
          boundary,
          requirement: `answer`,
          error: fixture.recorder.error(errors.source),
          peerPending: selectedRequest(program.answerScopes.peer) !== void 0
        };
        break;
      case `facade-rollback`:
        observation = {
          ...common,
          boundary,
          committedAt: selectedOutput(`A-forward`).acceptedAt,
          threwAt: need(
            events(`facade-injected-throw`).at(-1),
            `actual B throw`
          ).sequence,
          forwardRequirement: `A-forward`,
          restorationRequirement: `A-restore`
        };
        break;
      case `installed-tail-exception`: {
        const status = program.gate === `initial-status-tail`;
        const callback = need(
          events(status ? `real-status-callback` : `root-callback`).at(-1),
          `actual installed callback`
        );

          events(

      });
  } catch (error) {
    failure = error;
  };
  liveCallbackComparison = false;
  let cleanupFailed = false;
  try {
    if (hold && hold.transaction.state !== `completed` && hold.transaction.state !== `failed`)
      hold.rollback();
  } catch (error) {
